claim.claim-text: 1. A deceleration mechanism (130; 140; 150), comprising a first gear (131) and a second gear (132), the deceleration mechanism (130; 140; 150) having:

an engagement projected part (131c), arranged on the first gear (131), formed in an arc shape having a first radius of curvature (R11) along a rotation direction of the first gear (131); and an engagement recessed part (132d), arranged on the second gear (132) and engaged with the engagement projected part (131c), wherein the engagement recessed part (132d) comprises:

a bottom (132e), arranged at a center of the engagement recessed part (132d) along a rotation direction of the second gear (132); and side wall parts (132f; 151), arranged on both sides of the bottom (132e) along the rotation direction of the second gear (132), the side wall parts (132f; 151) are arc-shaped recessed parts or arc-shaped projected parts having a second radius of curvature (R31; R41) larger than the first radius of curvature (R11).
2. The deceleration mechanism (130; 140; 150) according to claim 1, wherein a size of the second radius of curvature (R31; R41) is at least twice a size of the first radius of curvature (R11).

3. The deceleration mechanism (130; 140; 150) according to claim 1, wherein a lubricating oil holding part (S1) for holding a lubricating oil (G1) is arranged between the engagement projected part (131c) and the bottom (132e).

4. The deceleration mechanism (140; 150) according to claim 1, wherein a build-up part (141) that narrows a gap (S1) formed between the engagement projected part (131c) and the bottom (132e) is arranged between the engagement projected part (131c) and the bottom (132e).
5. A deceleration mechanism (160), comprising a first gear (131) and a second gear (132), the deceleration mechanism (160) having:

an engagement projected part (131c), arranged on the first gear (131) and formed in an arc shape along a rotation direction of the first gear (131); and an engagement recessed part (132d), arranged on the second gear (132) and engaged with the engagement projected part (131c), wherein the engagement recessed part (132d) comprises:

a bottom (132e), arranged at a center of the engagement recessed part (132d) along a rotation direction of the second gear (132), and side wall parts (161), arranged on both sides of the bottom (132e) along the rotation direction of the second gear (132), the side wall parts (161) are flat surfaces extending straight from the bottom (132e).

6. The deceleration mechanism (160) according to claim 5, wherein a lubricating oil holding part (S1) for holding a lubricating oil (G1) is arranged between the engagement projected part (131c) and the bottom (132e).

7. The deceleration mechanism (160) according to claim 5, wherein a build-up part (141) that narrows a gap (S1) formed between the engagement projected part (131c) and the bottom (132e) is arranged between the engagement projected part (131c) and the bottom (132e).

8. A motor (110) having deceleration mechanism (130; 140; 150) installed therein, which has a deceleration mechanism (130; 140; 150) comprising a first gear (131) and a second gear (132) and comprises a rotary shaft (131) for driving the first gear (131) to rotate, the motor (110) having deceleration mechanism (130; 140; 150) installed therein having:

an engagement projected part (131c), arranged on the first gear (131) and formed in an arc shape having a first radius of curvature (R11) along a rotation direction of the first gear (131); and an engagement recessed part (132d), arranged on the second gear (132) and engaged with the engagement projected part (131c), wherein the engagement recessed part (132d) comprises:

a bottom (132e), arranged at a center of the engagement recessed part (132d) along a rotation direction of the second gear, and side wall parts (132f; 151), arranged on both sides of the bottom (132e) along the rotation direction of the second gear (132), the side wall parts (132f; 151) are arc-shaped recessed parts or arc-shaped projected parts having a second radius of curvature (R31; R41) larger than the first radius of curvature (R11).

9. The motor (110) having deceleration mechanism (130; 140; 150) installed therein according to claim 8, wherein a size of the second radius of curvature (R31; R41) is at least twice a size of the first radius of curvature (R11).

10. The motor (110) having deceleration mechanism (130; 140; 150) installed therein according to claim 8, wherein a lubricating oil holding part (S1) for holding a lubricating oil (G1) is arranged between the engagement projected part (131c) and the bottom (132e).

11. The motor (110) having deceleration mechanism (140; 150) installed therein according to claim 8, wherein a build-up part (141) that narrows a gap (S1) formed between the engagement projected part (131c) and the bottom (132e) is arranged between the engagement projected part (131c) and the bottom (132e).

12. A motor (110) having deceleration mechanism (160) installed therein, which has a deceleration mechanism (160) comprising a first gear (131) and a second gear (132) and comprises a rotary shaft (131) for driving the first gear (131) to rotate, the motor (110) having deceleration mechanism (160) installed therein having:

an engagement projected part (131c), arranged on the first gear (131) and formed in an arc shape along a rotation direction of the first gear (131); and an engagement recessed part (132d), arranged on the second gear (132) and engaged with the engagement projected part (131c), wherein the engagement recessed part (132d) comprises:

a bottom (132e), arranged at a center of the engagement recessed part (132d) along a rotation direction of the second gear (132); and side wall parts (161), arranged on both sides of the bottom (132e) along the rotation direction of the second gear (132), the side wall parts (161) are flat surfaces extending straight from the bottom (132e).

13. The motor (110) having deceleration mechanism (160) installed therein according to claim 12, wherein a lubricating oil holding part (S1) for holding a lubricating oil (G1) is arranged between the engagement projected part (131c) and the bottom (132e).

14. The motor (110) having deceleration mechanism (160) installed therein according to claim 12, wherein a build-up part (141) that narrows a gap (S1) formed between the engagement projected part (131c) and the bottom (132e) is arranged between the engagement projected part (131c) and the bottom (132e).
